projecthero.omnitrix.alien_x.reality_bol: A white-hot bolt of starlight from two fingers: 17 to the first creature in a 32-block line.
Both palms open a wide beam of the cosmos: 20 to everything within 1.6 blocks of a 40-block line.
projecthero.omnitrix.alien_x.telekinetic: Lifts the creature you look at (24 blocks) and flings it where you look: 16 and launched (a boss barely moves).
projecthero.omnitrix.alien_x.gravity_cru: Gravity multiplied: everything within 6 is slammed into the ground for 18 and slowed for 3 s.
projecthero.omnitrix.alien_x.blink.desc: Steps through reality to where you look (up to 48 blocks), leaving a closing tear behind.
projecthero.omnitrix.alien_x.cosmic_flig: Toggles flight. Landing again needs no vote.
projecthero.omnitrix.alien_x.time_stop.d: Stops the moment within 12 blocks: every creature frozen for 5 s (a boss for 1.25 s), arrows hang in the air.
projecthero.omnitrix.alien_x.reality_rif: Tears a hole into the starfield up to 24 blocks away: for 3 s it drags in everything within 6 and hits for 3 every half second (18).
projecthero.omnitrix.alien_x.restore.des: Rewrites your own body: +24 health, every harmful effect and the fire undone.
projecthero.omnitrix.alien_x.rewind.desc: Undoes the last 5 seconds for yourself: back where you stood, at least as healthy as you were then.
projecthero.omnitrix.alien_x.cosmic_shoc: A ring of starlight races out to 8 blocks: 19 and thrown back.
projecthero.omnitrix.alien_x.big_bang.de: ULTIMATE: a universe's birth in miniature -- 65 at the centre to 45 at the edge of a 10-block blast, everything flung away.
projecthero.guide.omnitrix.alien.alien_x: Alien X, the Celestialsapien: reality itself bends to him -- but every move is first debated by Serena and Bellicus, and a quarter of the motions are denied.
projecthero.omnitrix.info.alien_x.passiv: Every move is put to a vote: 1.5 s frozen while Serena and Bellicus debate, then 75% it happens.
A Celestialsapien breathes nothing and falls without harm: no drowning, no fall damage.
60 health and armour 14: the toughest body on the dial.
projecthero.omnitrix.info.alien_x.weakne: Frozen while they argue: no walking, jumping or punching during a debate.
A quarter of the motions are denied (a 3 s wait on that move).
Transforming opens with a 5 s debate in which nothing can be done.
projecthero.omnitrix.alien_x.debate.sere: If it must be done, let it be done gently.
Consider the creatures caught in its path.
The boy asks politely. I see no harm in it.
Every act echoes across a billion worlds.
Mercy is also a kind of strength.
Let us at least weigh it before we act.
He means well. I am inclined to agree.
Patience. The universe is not going anywhere.
projecthero.omnitrix.alien_x.debate.bell: Enough talk! Strike and be done with it!
Why ask permission? We are reality!
Every second we argue, they get away!
Fine, fine -- but make it hurt.
The little one finally has a good idea.
Do it before I change my mind!
projecthero.omnitrix.alien_x.opening.ser: A third voice has joined the council.
projecthero.omnitrix.alien_x.opening.bel: Another one? Throw it back out!
projecthero.omnitrix.alien_x.opening.ser: He is only a boy. Let us hear what he wants.
projecthero.omnitrix.alien_x.opening.bel: He wants to use OUR body. Outrageous.
projecthero.omnitrix.alien_x.opening.ser: Then each act shall be put to a vote.
projecthero.omnitrix.alien_x.opening.bel: And a quarter of them I will refuse. Gladly.
projecthero.omnitrix.alien_x.opening.ser: Agreed. The motion to let him act is carried.
message.projecthero.omnitrix.alien_x.bus: Serena and Bellicus are still debating.
message.projecthero.omnitrix.alien_x.sea: The council is seated. Alien X may act.
